title: BBC Learning English from the News 2025 — Quiz 5
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q041_abyss
elements.title: Without support, the business could sink into an ___ of mounting debt that it might never escape.

elements.name: q042_last_hope
elements.title: With every other route closed, catching the last ferry was their ___ of getting home that night.

elements.name: q043_push_back
elements.title: Residents began to ___ against the closure by circulating a petition.

elements.name: q044_dose
elements.title: The presenter added a generous ___ of humour to an otherwise serious speech.

elements.name: q045_debunk
elements.title: The researcher used records and photographs to ___ the claim that the bridge had never existed.

elements.name: q046_rising_chorus
elements.title: The council heard a ___ of complaints as more residents joined in.

elements.name: q047_hold_someone_or_something_responsible
elements.title: The inquiry will decide whether to hold the contractor ___ for the damage.

elements.name: q048_sloppy
elements.title: The rushed report was ___, with spelling mistakes and missing totals.

elements.name: q049_nickname
elements.title: The children decided to ___ their dog “Professor” because he always looked so serious.

elements.name: q050_whiz
elements.title: Ravi is a spreadsheet ___ who can fix even the most complicated formulas.
